regionField.label: Where are you? (town, city or region)

starter: Hi, thank you for reaching out. I'm here to listen. How are you feeling right now?
I'm still here with you. Take whatever time you need.
I want to make sure you are safe right now. Are you somewhere safe at the moment?
Sorry to keep you waiting — I'm still with you, just taking a moment to reply properly.
Thank you for talking with me today. Please remember you can reach us again any time. Take care of yourself.
If you are in immediate danger, please call your local emergency number right now. Would you like to talk through what is happening?
I have been trained as a support worker.
I am working under professional supervision.
